title: Unity AI (Muse & Sentis) for Unity 6
summary: A production-ready suite of AI tools integrated into Unity 6 for game development. It includes Unity Muse for generative asset creation and chat-based assistant workflows, and Unity Sentis for high-performance cross-platform local neural network inference.
research_notes: Unity Muse requires a paid subscription for generative features, while Unity Sentis is a free runtime tool included with the engine for local AI inference.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from beta to core production-ready status in Unity 6. Muse has added video-to-motion and text-to-motion capabilities, while Sentis now supports native PyTorch and LiteRT model imports without conversion as of 2026.
